note: Versioned pipeline registry (docs/15). Which pipeline delivers is owned by the SWITCH: `active` in config/delivery_profiles.json, thrown with `python scripts/pipeline.py --use <id>` (--on = Google Flow Nano Banana 2, --off = Higgsfield). Never hand-edit the derived flags here. Switching is deliberate and manual in both directions; nothing auto-selects. `legacy` = Higgsfield renders the whole image including the ring, 2048x2048 native. `gflow-nb2` = Google Flow Nano Banana 2 (engine 2, model NARWHAL), 1536x1536 delivered by upscaling the 768x1376 native render to 1536x2752 and centre-cropping. `composite-v1` is retained for optional studio-only geometry-guarantee, not selectable as a delivery profile. The preserved logo is composited locally in EVERY pipeline (docs/04 P0) - that is not a pipeline choice. Geometry fidelity is held by locked prompts + QC + iteration in both delivery pipelines, not guaranteed by construction.

policy.active_activation: gflow-nb2 IS THE DELIVERY PIPELINE by explicit, repeated user instruction 2026-08-22 ('Use google nano banana 2 pipeline do not use higgsfield now'), which supersedes the 2026-07-21 'use only Higgsfield' instruction. The user accepted the resulting 1536x1536 delivered format (43.75% less pixel area than 2048x2048). Automatic switching stays forbidden in both directions - only scripts/pipeline.py, run by explicit user instruction, changes `active`.

composite-v1.description: RETAINED, NOT PRODUCTION (user-instructed 2026-07-21). Higgsfield renders only the scene; the real source-CAD ring is composited in - geometry identical by construction, but ONLY for studio angles the 2D CAD covers; it cannot produce worn lifestyle/close-up shots. Kept intact for optional studio geometry-guarantee; not selected automatically.

legacy.description: AVAILABLE, not live (user switched away 2026-08-22). The original Higgsfield MCP lifecycle that generated the approved catalogs: Higgsfield renders the scene AND the jewelry from the geometry-locked prompts at 2048x2048 native; the preserved logo is composited locally afterwards (docs/04 P0). Switch back with: python scripts/pipeline.py --off

gflow-nb2.name: gflow-nb2
gflow-nb2.description: DELIVERY PIPELINE (user-instructed 2026-08-22). Nano Banana 2 reached DIRECTLY through Google Flow via the openflow MCP bridge, not through Higgsfield. Renders 768x1376 portrait natively, upscaled to 1536x2752 and centre-cropped to the delivered 1536x1536 square. Requires the openflow MCP server connected. Also used for Veo video.

terminology.Higgsfield: Engine 1. Delivers at 2048x2048 native, 2 credits/image. Available, not live.
terminology.Google Flow / gflow-nb2: Engine 2, THE LIVE DELIVERY PIPELINE. Nano Banana 2 as model id NARWHAL, 1536x1536 delivered.
terminology.Composite-first: `composite-v1`. Retained for studio-only geometry-guarantee; not a delivery profile.
terminology.Logo compositing: NOT a pipeline. The preserved logo is composited locally in every pipeline (docs/04 P0).
terminology.Nano Banana 2 - two routes, do not confu: The SAME model, two routes with different ids. Via Higgsfield it is `nano_banana_2` (config/model.json, MODEL_LOCK). Via Google Flow it is `NARWHAL`. MODEL_LOCK governs the Higgsfield call only; on the gflow-nb2 pipeline the model id comes from config/delivery_profiles.json.
